theorems.name: Submission.p10_17ae7b7d_cpo_rotation_invariant
theorems.statement: ∀ (w : ℕ) (ζ : ℂ) (A : ℂ → ℂ), 0 < w → ζ ^ w = 1 → let P : ℂ → ℂ := fun t => ∏ j ∈ Finset.range w, A (ζ ^ j * t); ∀ t : ℂ, P (ζ * t) = P t
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
